verdict.rationale: Ledgy's trading-and-settlement docs show employees can submit market orders (sell to cover, sell all, hold all) and receive payouts via an integrated paying agent in 170 countries/60 currencies, suggesting some self-service equity transaction capability, but none of the evidence explicitly describes an online option-exercise workflow with strike-price payment and resulting share issuance. Missing for 10: explicit exercise workflow (selecting options to exercise), online payment of exercise cost, and confirmation that shares are issued/cap table updated as a direct result of exercise (rather than just secondary sale/liquidity events).
